subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI kicks authenticated sessions to the login gate on any WebSocket drop instead of degrading gracefully

question: Should maintainers use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100479 as the fixing path for this protected Control UI reconnect issue?
rationale: The issue has a protected `maintainer` label and an open closing PR, so cleanup automation should not close or queue a parallel fix without maintainer review of that PR.

options.title: Review the linked fix PR
options.body: Use the open PR as the candidate implementation and close this issue only after that PR merges or is replaced by an equivalent maintainer-approved fix.

options.title: Choose a different fix shape
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for a narrower or differently layered Control UI reconnect patch if the linked PR is not acceptable.

recommendation.title: Review the linked fix PR
recommendation.body: Use the open PR as the candidate implementation and close this issue only after that PR merges or is replaced by an equivalent maintainer-approved fix.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current routing candidate from recent Control UI history and authored the linked fix PR.
